description: Show the wallet balance, the starter gift part, how much can be sent out, today's remaining limits, and all fees, privacy notes and rules. Call this before sending. Needs the header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' (your wallet key from create_wallet). Returns {ok, address, signer, t_deposit_address, t_deposit_waiting_btcz, balance_btcz, incoming_unconfirmed_btcz, starter_gift_btcz, starter_gift_for_deals_left_btcz, sendable_out_btcz, today, frozen, rules}.
name: balance
